from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
before = json.loads(Path('evidence/coder-before.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
after = {'phase': 'after implementation and passing targeted mark_paid unit tests', 'recorded_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'files': {}}
diff = []
for path, original in before['files'].items():
    data = Path(path).read_bytes()
    text = data.decode('utf-8')
    sha256 = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    after['files'][path] = {'sha256': sha256, 'text': text}
    diff.extend(difflib.unified_diff(original['text'].replace('\\r\\n', '\\n').splitlines(keepends=True), text.replace('\\r\\n', '\\n').splitlines(keepends=True), fromfile=f'before/{path}', tofile=f'after/{path}'))
    print(f'{path}: {sha256}; changed={sha256 "'!= original["sha256"]}'"')
Path('evidence/coder-after.json').write_text(json.dumps(after, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
Path('evidence/coder-diff.patch').write_text(''.join(diff), encoding='utf-8')
assert after['files']['src/order_service.py']['sha256'] == before['files']['src/order_service.py']['sha256']
assert after['files']['src/storage.py']['sha256'] == before['files']['src/storage.py']['sha256']
print('Unmodified order_service/storage byte hashes verified. Exit code: 0')
'@ | python -B -"
